source_supplements.note: BackupController.UploadAndRestore requires multipart Request.Form.Files, absent from the OpenAPI requestBody.
MediaCoverController returns dynamic image content as PhysicalFile, absent from OpenAPI response content. Binary responses use a JSON base64 envelope.
StaticResourceController source uses catch-all routes; path encoding preserves slash separators.
Documented routes are build dependent and the deployed production instance returns HTTP 404.
CommandController dynamically deserializes named command subtypes, so body accepts arbitrary command-specific fields beyond the OpenAPI CommandResource.
Source factory reset deletes database, configuration, API key, authentication settings and media covers, then restarts Chaptarr.
Source excludes this browser initialization resource from OpenAPI. It requires UI authentication and may return the API key.
